author: Home Repair Tutor
description: Kitchen tile floor removal shouldn’t be this easy. I never use 1/4 inch plywood because tile won’t bond properly and it’s not strong. Instead, I use 3/4 inch plywood over 16 inch on-center floor joists. Then I use DITRA uncoupling membrane. This ensures the new tile won’t crack and will last a very long time
title: Kitchen Tile Floor Removal - #kitchenfloortiles #tileflooring #howto
